nodes.name: Every 2 Hours :07
nodes.notes: Discovery Engine trigger. Runs hourly at :07 (America/New_York). Workflow stays INACTIVE until explicit approval.

nodes.name: Load Config
nodes.notes: Reads score weights and thresholds from viral_config. No hardcoded values in the workflow.

nodes.name: Init Run
nodes.notes: Builds run_id + typed config (defaults, weight normalization, sanity checks). Downstream nodes read $('Init Run').first().json.config

nodes.name: Get Active Sources
nodes.notes: Watchlist: active YouTube sources by priority. alwaysOutputData ON: empty watchlist must not stop the charts branch (handled in next Code node).

nodes.name: Needs Channel ID
nodes.notes: Only sources with a handle but no uploads_playlist_id go to resolution.

nodes.name: YT Resolve Handle
nodes.notes: channels.list forHandle = 1 quota unit. Runs only once per new source.

nodes.name: Map Resolved IDs
nodes.notes: Pairs channels.list responses with source rows; emits only resolved sources.

nodes.name: Save Source IDs
nodes.notes: Writes external_id + uploads_playlist_id into viral_sources (by row id).

nodes.name: Build Watchlist Requests
nodes.notes: One item per creator with a known uploads playlist (uses IDs resolved in this same run).

nodes.name: YT Uploads
nodes.notes: playlistItems.list: latest N uploads per creator. 1 quota unit per creator.

nodes.name: Get Tracked Candidates
nodes.notes: Candidates to refresh (WATCHING/ELIGIBLE) + any recent row of any status, so Discovery never overwrites SELECTED/READY/PUBLISHED. alwaysOutputData: table may be empty.

nodes.name: YT Charts US
nodes.notes: videos.list chart=mostPopular US. 1 unit per page; pages limited by config.charts_max_pages. Secondary source (Music/Film excluded later).

nodes.name: Build Video Batches
nodes.notes: Merges IDs from watchlist (recent only), tracked candidates and charts. Batches of 50 for videos.list. First item carries meta + stats.

nodes.name: YT Video Details
nodes.notes: videos.list for up to 50 IDs per call = 1 quota unit per batch.

nodes.name: Score & State
nodes.notes: Metrics + Trend Score (pure math) + state machine. Never touches rows owned by Factory/Publisher. New videos failing hard filters are not stored.

nodes.name: Has Rows
nodes.notes: Drops the placeholder item when no candidate was produced.

nodes.name: Upsert Candidates
nodes.notes: Upsert by candidate_key (unique key youtube:<videoId>).

nodes.name: Insert Snapshots
nodes.notes: One snapshot per candidate per run (history for velocity/acceleration and analytics).

nodes.name: Build Run Log
nodes.notes: Counts, estimated quota, HTTP errors, config warnings.

nodes.name: Write Run Log
nodes.notes: One row per run in viral_runs.

nodes.name: Prune Old Snapshots
nodes.notes: Retention: deletes snapshots older than config.snapshot_retention_days. Runs every hour (cheap, usually 0 rows).

nodes.name: Get Twitch Sources
nodes.notes: Active Twitch streamers from viral_sources (handle = Twitch login).

nodes.name: Twitch Users
nodes.notes: helix/users: login -> broadcaster id (one call for all streamers).

nodes.name: Build Clip Requests
nodes.notes: One clips request per streamer + refresh of tracked Twitch clips. Always >= 1 item.

nodes.name: Twitch Clips
nodes.notes: helix/clips: most viewed clips of the window, or refresh by id.

nodeGroups.name: Setup
nodeGroups.description: Load config and build run context

nodeGroups.name: Resolve Channel IDs
nodeGroups.description: One-time @handle -> channel ID / uploads playlist for new sources

nodeGroups.name: Watchlist
nodeGroups.description: Latest uploads of each active creator

nodeGroups.name: Tracked + Charts
nodeGroups.description: Existing candidates to refresh + YouTube mostPopular US

nodeGroups.name: Video Details
nodeGroups.description: Merge YouTube IDs and fetch stats (50 per call)

nodeGroups.name: Twitch Clips
nodeGroups.description: Streamers watchlist -> most viewed clips of the last 48h + refresh
